meta.title: Contact US - Antiwordle
meta.description: Contact the Antiwordle team for feedback, questions, bug reports, or site-related requests.

sections.title: Get in touch
body: Questions, feedback, bug reports, and suggestions are welcome.
You can contact us by email at info@antiwordle.com.

sections.title: Helpful details to include
body: If you are reporting a bug, please include your browser, device, the date of the puzzle, and what happened before the issue appeared.
